question: Zakir travels from City A to City B. If Zakir drives his car at (3)/(8) of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 45 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Zakir would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drives at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (New : Normal) = 3 : 8

Time ratio (New : Normal) = 8 : 3 (Since time ∝ 1/speed)

Difference in time ratio = 8 − 3 = 5 units

Given delay = 45 minutes ⇒ 5 units = 45 minutes

Normal time = 3 units = 3 × 9 = 27 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 27 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
 
 City A
 City B
 
 

 Normal Speed = v
 Normal Time = t
 
 

 New Speed = 3/8 v
 New Time = t + 45

**Given:**

New speed = 3/8 of normal speed.

Delay time = 45 minutes.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

When the distance is constant, Speed and Time are inversely proportional.

**Calculations:**

Let the normal speed be v and the normal time taken be t minutes.

⇒ Distance covered normally = v × t

⇒ Distance covered at new speed = (3v/8) × (t + 45)

Since the distance is the same in both cases, we can equate them:

⇒ v × t = (3v/8) × (t + 45)

⇒ t = 3/8 × (t + 45)

⇒ 8t = 3(t + 45)

⇒ 8t = 3t + 135

⇒ 5t = 135

⇒ t = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportionality

When the distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional. This means S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂.

Average Speed

For multiple trips of equal distance with speeds x and y, the average speed for the whole journey is given by 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

If two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed = x + y. If moving in the same direction, relative speed = |x − y|.
